title: Concept: Query duration returned with results
description: A timing figure in milliseconds beside the result count in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The timing lets an attacker measure how expensive a query is, which is the feedback a blind injection needs to infer data one character at a time.
applicability: Deployments that render a timing figure in milliseconds beside the result count into a customer- or partner-facing response.
